title: Corelib test matrix and release evidence (fresh run required)
body: Record a fresh corelib gate for the reconciled compiler candidate and attach the exact command, compiler/corelib pins, target count, and retained report. This task is not complete until the active OpenSpec release ledger's migration, retirement, runtime-kit, and sign-off obligations have current evidence. Historical 42/42 and wave-completion statements are not release evidence.
